subject: Controlling Bar Width in geom_bar for Categorical Variables

messages.author: 0f7afe3850f58838
messages.subject: Controlling Bar Width in geom_bar for Categorical Variables
parts:
I would like to control the width of the bars in a categorical stacked
barchart. I thought this might be possible with Here is a
reproducible example:

a <- data.frame(type=c(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), 4)),
variable=c(sort(rep(c("a", "b", "c", "d"), 3))),
value = c(30, 20, 50, 20, 40, 40, 10, 80, 10, 5, 20,
75))
p <-ggplot(a, aes(x=factor(variable), y=value, fill = type)) + geom_bar
()
p
